extracted.intended_audience: systems researchers and practitioners; OSDI authors, speakers, and attendees
extracted.subtask_description: Information page for the 17th USENIX OSDI symposium describing the conference's emphasis and logistical/policy requirements relevant to authors, speakers, and attendees. Useful for understanding what kinds of submissions and conduct the conference values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emphasis on innovative research
rubrics_metrics.description: The symposium emphasizes innovative research in the design, implementation, and implications of systems software.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OSDI is a premier forum for discussing design, implementation, and implications of systems software; submissions and presentations should foreground novel, innovative contributions to these areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emphasis on quantified or insightful experiences
rubrics_metrics.description: The symposium emphasizes quantified or insightful experiences in systems design and implementation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work that presents measured (quantified) results or offers insightful experience reports about systems design and implementation is specifically valued alongside innovative research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open access to research
rubrics_metrics.description: As part of our commitment to open access to research, the full proceedings and presentation slides are free and open to the public on the technical sessions page; videos are posted within a few weeks of the end of the event.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should expect their accepted papers and slides to be made publicly available; presentation materials will be posted as part of the symposium's open-access policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adherence to USENIX conference policies and Code of Conduct
rubrics_metrics.description: Attendees and participants are encouraged to learn more about USENIX's values and how they are put into practice; a Code of Conduct applies to conference participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Speakers, authors, and attendees are expected to follow USENIX policies and the Code of Conduct. The page links to those policies for details (behavioral and procedural expectations are enforced via those policies).

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility requests and deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: To ensure that accessibility needs are met, requests should be made by Monday, June 19, 2023; USENIX cannot guarantee meeting requests received after this date, though reasonable efforts will be made.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors/speakers/attendees requiring accommodations must submit requests by the stated deadline to maximize the chance their needs can be met.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration, hotel, and cancellation logistics and deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Early Bird Registration Deadline: Friday, June 23, 2023. Cancellation deadline: Monday, June 26, 2023. Special attendee room rate available until Friday, June 23, 2023 (or until block sells out).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors and speakers must handle registration and travel logistics within the deadlines; contact Conference Department for registration information. Review the Registration Substitution and Cancellation Policy for refund/substitution rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsorship policy (no program control or endorsement implied)
rubrics_metrics.description: The acceptance of any organization as a sponsor does not imply explicit or implicit approval by USENIX of the sponsoring organization’s values or actions; sponsorship does not provide any control over conference program content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors and attendees should note that sponsorships do not influence program content; questions about sponsorship can be directed to the provided contact email.
